name: My Backyard ADU Project Feels Overwhelming, Where Do I Start?

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Vision - This is where you chat with a builder about your ideas, needs, and what you hope to achieve with your ADU. A good contractor like Cali View Builders will listen first, helping you define your vision and understand initial possibilities. This typically takes a week or two for initial discussions and site visits.
step.text: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Vision - This is where you chat with a builder about your ideas, needs, and what you hope to achieve with your ADU. A good contractor like Cali View Builders will listen first, helping you define your vision and understand initial possibilities. This typically takes a week or two for initial discussions and site visits.

step.name: Step 2: Design and Planning - Now it's time to turn those ideas into actual blueprints. This phase involves architectural drawings, selecting materials, and finalizing the layout. We coordinate this part, ensuring everything aligns with your vision and local zoning. This can range from 1 to 3 months, depending on design complexity and revisions.

step.name: Step 3: Permitting - This step is crucial and involves submitting your approved plans to the city for all necessary permits. It's often the part homeowners find most daunting, but we handle the coordination to streamline the process. Permit approval times vary widely by city in Los Angeles County, but expect 1-4 months.

step.name: Step 4: Construction - With permits in hand, construction begins! This includes everything from foundation work and framing to electrical, plumbing, insulation, and finishes. Our team manages all the trades and keeps you updated on progress. This is the longest phase, usually taking 4-8 months for an average backyard ADU.

step.name: Step 5: Final Inspection and Handover - Once construction is complete, the city performs final inspections to ensure everything meets code. After passing, we do a thorough walkthrough with you, address any final touches, and hand over your new ADU. This last step typically wraps up within a couple of weeks after construction.
